Get Better Results With Dedicated Remote Developers

Mobilunity has developed a unique 3R Model ensuring a perfect match between the tech and business side of your project. It’s driven by three criteria: Relationships, Recruitment, and Retention.

1R

Relationships

We build deep, flexible, and trustful partnerships by prioritizing сommunication and human connections. The Relationships represent our client-centric approach. By providing regular feedback, we make our cooperation mutually beneficial.

2R

Recruitment

Our Recruitment is all about a transparent, cost-effective, and fast recruiting process. We tackle your specific hiring needs with use-proven approaches, effectively mitigating risks and helping you find the right talent who lasts.

3R

Retention

We focus on Retention and Motivation of every remote developer in your team. Relying on regular feedback from your software architects and engineers, we spot issues and inefficiencies early, minimizing potential turnover.

Benefits of Hiring Remote Developers With Us

Transparency

We believe in being open and clear in everything we do. With Mobilunity, you always know what’s happening with your remote engineers and software project development. We keep you updated so you can trust us.

Custom Hiring

Tailoring your dev team’s expertise to your project requirements is what we’ve done for years. Whether you need one programmer or a team of remote developers, we’ll find the right people for you. Your team, your way.

Replacement Guarantee

Mistakes happen, and we get that. If something isn’t working out with your team member, we’ve got your back. Mobilunity offers a replacement guarantee, ensuring you always have the right people on board.

Global Talent Pool

We have a vast reserve of brilliant programmers ready to join your project. No matter the skills, tools, and technologies your product demands, we hire developers who bring your ideas to life.

Rich Experience

With over a decade in the business, we bring a wealth of experience to the table. We’ve built nearly a hundred tech teams and know how to accept challenges.

Cost-Effective Approach

Access flexible fee-setting approaches that suit your project best through one of our cooperation models. Be sure to get accurate estimates and fair pricing without hidden expenses.

Our Hiring Process

{01}

Set Your Project Needs

Once you choose to hire remote developers from us, consider the approximate project duration. Assess how many skilled developers you’ll need and think of their tech stack.

{02}

Submit Your Request

Whether you prefer hiring a remote team or a single developer, fill in the contact form. We’ll process your inquiry for dedicated remote developers in 48 hours and call back for details.

{03}

Get an Estimate & Offer

In a few days, our specialists will send you the total cost of hiring remote developers and its breakdown. Once approved, we sign the NDA, initiate the search, and send you CVs.

{04}

Join Interviews

As our recruiters hire dedicated remote developers for you, they arrange HR and tech interviews. You can join these assessments or arrange conversations with shortlisted candidates only.

{05}

Sign Your Agreement

Once your coders confirm all details and accept job offers, we reach them out once again to sign a cooperation agreement with you. Soon, you can start working with your new developers.

Our Cooperation Models

Dedicated Remote Developers

Once you hire a team of experienced software developers full-time, you get their back-office support. You pay a fixed monthly price and we cover the accounting, legal, payroll, and HR services. Since remote coders we hire are skilled and use the latest technologies and high-quality software, your team members can freely focus on their core responsibilities.

HIRE DEDICATED DEVELOPERS

FLEX Remote Developers On-Demand

The FLEX model is best when you need to empower your in-office developers with specific expertise or, for instance, engage several full-stack developers for 20 hours a week or less. Mobilunity also handles all the administrative issues related to your part-time remote workers. Just like EORs but with much more benefits!

HIRE FLEX DEVELOPERS PART-TIME

Frequently Asked Questions

Will you advise me if I am hesitant about the right tech stack for my web development project?

Sure. We understand that choosing the technologies for some software solutions can be overwhelming. So, whether you need to hire dedicated programmers or part-time developers, Mobilunity will help. We’ll advise on the optimized stack for your software development and ensure it’ll fit your project goals and budget.

Will I pay for recruiting if I hire remote developers?

Under the Dedicated Development Team format with all-inclusive pricing model, the recruiting is free. However, if you select our RaaS (Recruiting as a Service), the fees will apply. They’ll consist of job board subscriptions, referral fees, ads, recruiters’ bonuses, etc., whichever will be applicable to help close your vacancy as quickly as possible.

What does all-inclusive pricing stand for?

It means that when you build a dedicated development team with Mobilunity, you pay for all the related services from searching to assisting your coders. The invoice includes expenses split into categories to show you the cost structure. This transparent approach demonstrates there are no hidden expenditures.

Do you assist with the technical interviewing of candidates?

Yes. We want to be sure your developers are experts, so Mobilunity offers tech interviews as a separate service with a per-meeting rate. However, under the DDT model, you’ll get an unlimited number of interviews for a fixed monthly fee.

How do you assess candidates when you hire remote developers?

Our strict vetting process allows us to contract top-notch developers for you. It includes evaluating technical skills, assessing relevant experience, and conducting interviews. We also check references to ensure the coders gained the mentioned experience.

In what locations do you hire remote developers?

With access to a global talent pool, our recruiters can find a game, security software, data science, or web developer in any remote location or time zone. Whether you need developers from Europe, Asia, LATAM, North America, the Middle East, or elsewhere, we’ll find professionals who’ll fit your requirements and working hours.

What are the steps of hiring developers with Mobilunity?

First, you complete the contact form. Within 48 hours on average, we’ll call back to talk about your project requirements. Next, we send you the CVs of pre-vetted developers. After you make your choice, we onboard the coders and ensure their smooth integration into your workflow.

Do you guarantee that your developer passes the trial period?

Our candidates’ assessing techniques allow us to be sure that your remote developer will pass the probation period. In fact, 93% of our candidates pass the trial period. However, if any issues arise, our specialists will address them promptly. In critical cases, we arrange replacements of coders for free during the first 90 days of cooperation.
